messages:
Alex: heads-up — noticed a spike in 'missing trace_id' errors for inference-gpu logs in us-east1. Kibana queries returning ~40% fewer trace ids after ~03:10 UTC. Does anyone else see this?
Priya: saw the grafana alert for loki:TraceIDMissingRate firing at 03:12. SLO for trace visibility degraded. Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/obs/traces?orgId=1 (can't access external)
Sam: confirming, Loki ingestion shows lots of HTTP 499/0 from our forwarder in us-east1. Sample from kubefwd: 
```
2026-03-18T03:09:58Z forwarder-xyz ERROR upstream write failed: net/http: request canceled (client disconnected) trace_id=
```
Alex: interesting — trace_id field is blank when the request disconnects mid-upload. Could be egress/network issue dropping headers before log parser sees them.
ops-bot: NAT-rotation job started by infra-scheduler at 03:05 UTC for us-east1 (reason: node pool scaling event). Job ID: nat-rot-20260318-0305
Mateo: that rotation touched the regional NAT gateway — we rotated SNAT IPs and scaled autoscaler down/up. We saw a short period of SNAT port exhaustion during the scale which caused outbound connection resets. Might explain the 499s.
Lina: runtime team — do our forwarders tolerate connection resets? They stream multi-line batches, losing a batch = missing trace ids for that batch.
Priya: I'm seeing this Loki query pattern: 
```
{namespace="inference", app="log-forwarder"} |= "write failed" | json | stats count() by trace_id
```
When I run it for 02:50-03:20, ~38% of entries have empty trace_id.
Alex: can we correlate with Prometheus SNAT metrics? Sam — any dashboards?
Sam: yes — prometheus rule `gke_nat_snat_port_usage` jumped above 0.95 at 03:06 in us-east1. Screenshot on infra-alerts channel. Also saw `nat_conn_reset_total` tick up.
Mateo: root cause: autoscaler scaled down infra nodes, NAT service attempted to reassign SNAT IPs; ephemeral port reuse hit limit briefly. Kubernetes sources opened many ephemeral outbound connections to our logging endpoint which exhausted SNAT entries for that IP.
Lina: short term mitigation: we can route log-forwarder egress through dedicated egress IPs (pin to reserved NAT) for the forwarder DaemonSet using an annotation, will avoid shared SNAT pool. I can patch a staging roll now.
Mateo: agreed — also increasing NAT pool size for us-east1 and adding a Prom rule to alert at 0.8 instead of 0.95.
Alex: action items: 1) Lina to patch forwarders for dedicated egress (staging -> prod after smoke). 2) Mateo to increase NAT pool and lower alert threshold. 3) Priya/Sam to run a backfill on missing traces for the 03:05-03:15 window if possible. 4) Add runbook entry for NAT-rotation impact on log ingestion.
Lina: starting a patch now, will post rollout status.
Priya: I'll kick off a backfill job against Loki; might need to re-ingest from hotstore snapshots.
Mateo: provisioning NAT pool change queued — ETA 25m. Also adding a prometheus recording rule for `snat_port_utilization:ratio` and alert at 80%.
Alex: thanks. Once Lina confirms forwarder rollout and Mateo confirms NAT changes, can someone re-run the Kibana trace_id coverage check? Want to see recovery timeline.
Sam: will run queries and post before/after numbers.
ops-bot: Deployment lina/forwarder-dedicated-egress started at 03:27 UTC, rollout id forwarder-ded-20260318-0327
Lina: rollout completed to 60% at 03:30, then to 100% at 03:34 — no errors in smoke.
Mateo: NAT pool increased and new IPs allocated at 03:48. Prometheus alerting threshold updated.
Priya: backfill started at 04:05, estimated 18m.
Alex: nice work, team. After backfill and a monitoring window, we should close the incident. Add postmortem note about SNAT exhaustion and add a test for NAT rotation in our staging chaos tests. :thumbsup:
Sam: posting before/after numbers to the thread: pre-fix trace coverage 62%, post-fix 98% (backfill included).
Priya: closing alert in grafana, will file follow-up tickets for runbook + chaos test.
Mateo: filing infra ticket: INFRA-3267 (increase per-region nat pool & add alerts).
Alex: thanks — please @me on the tickets.
Lina: done.
Priya: marking incident resolved in #incidents and adding timeline to the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
